description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeProfilePictureController class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It handles pre-rendering logic for the employee profile picture view, setting components and permissions based on the employee number retrieved from the request. It extends a base controller and interacts with Vue components, permissions, and employee picture data.

classes.name: EmployeeProfilePictureController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing the employee profile picture component and permissions prior to rendering. Extends BaseViewEmployeeController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with employee-specific properties and sets permissions based on employee number from the request.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the data groups (permissions) required for capability check, specifically for 'photograph'.
